extension.description: Automatically selects preferred-language Signs/Songs/Forced subtitle tracks on episode transitions. Extends Kodi's forced_only mode to also pick up tracks named "signs", "songs", or "forced" that aren't flagged as forced in the container. Reads your preferred subtitle language directly from Kodi's own language and subtitle settings — no separate configuration needed.
extension.news:
v0.7.1 - Select and confirm Signs/Songs tracks that share the same name and flags.
v0.7.0 - Confirm subtitle changes before announcements and PKC results. - Retry delayed streams for ten seconds and preserve manual subtitle choices. - Empty keywords disable name matching; forced tracks remain eligible.
v0.6.1 - Fix subtitle tracks not being recognised as the preferred language when Kodi names it differently from the track (for example "Portuguese (Brazil)", "Norwegian", or German coded deu versus ger); more languages are now understood.
v0.6.0 - Fix the subtitle being left as the previous episode's choice right after an episode change: a "keep the current subtitle" decision is now confirmed once before it is final. - A selection still running for the previous file can no longer change the subtitles of the next one. - Publish the result for PlexKodiConnect (SmartSubtitles.Result), so PKC applies the Plex subtitle choice when no Signs/Songs/Forced track was found or the add-on is turned off in its settings. - An unexpected error now ends that one selection with a logged traceback; the service no longer wakes every second and releases the player on shutdown. - The publish checks now run the add-on's tests.
v0.5.5 - Enforce the Primez versioning rules in the publish checks; nothing in the add-on changes.
v0.5.4 - Add publish rule checks (pre-push hook and CI workflow); nothing in the add-on changes.
v0.5.3 - Prefer tracks Kodi flags as forced, and never turn off Kodi's subtitle when no better match exists. - Match keywords as whole words and skip full-dialogue tracks ("Full Subtitles (Dialogue + Signs & Songs)", "Designed by", "Non-Forced" no longer match). - forced_only users with a non-English Kodi UI keep their own-language forced track. - Warn once in the log if an older PlexKodiConnect would override the selection. v0.5.2 - Add Claude Code project settings (not packaged). v0.5.1 - Preferred language now comes from Kodi's ``locale.subtitlelanguage`` ("Preferred subtitle language") when it is set to an actual language. Special values (original, default, forced_only, none) fall back to ``subtitles.languages`` ("Languages to download subtitles for"), then to the Kodi UI language. Region suffixes such as "Portuguese (Brazil)" are normalized. - Retry thread is now cancellable: stop, end, error or a new playback cancels the in-flight attempt, it stops when Kodi shuts down, and it never acts on a different file than the one it started for. - New setting "Show notification when a track is selected" (on by default). v0.5.0 - Source of truth for preferred language is now Kodi's own ``subtitles.languages`` setting (read via JSON-RPC). No separate addon setting to drift out of sync — change it in Kodi's Player > Subtitles UI and this addon respects it immediately. Falls back to the Kodi UI locale if the setting is empty. - Broadened the language normalization map (~25 common languages) so non-English anime muxes with multi-language Forced/Signs tracks are filtered correctly. - Kodi's ``forced_only`` mode auto-picks the first forced-flagged track by stream index regardless of language (e.g. Portuguese (Forced) at index 0). This addon now detects that case and disables the non-preferred forced track before scanning for a preferred-language match, rather than leaving you on a forced track in a language you don't read. - Stale-index guard now validates the reported current index against the actual stream list for THIS file, not just index > 0. v0.4.0 - Only auto-select tracks in the configured preferred subtitle languages (English by default). This prevents a similarly named Forced or Signs/Songs track in another language from overriding the intended subtitle, and disables an automatically selected non-preferred forced track. v0.3.0 - Fix auto-select skipped on episode transitions. Kodi reports a stale `currentsubtitle.index` for tens of ms after onAVStarted (carry-over from the previous file), which fooled the 'don't override user choice' guard. The guard now also requires `subtitleenabled=true`, which is the reliable signal that Kodi has resolved the new file's subtitle state. When forced_only finds no flagged forced track on the new file, Kodi disables subtitles entirely — addon now correctly fires in that case. v0.2.0 - Add 'forced' to default keywords so tracks named 'Forced' (e.g. anime release-group variants like 'Forced (freeka)', 'Forced (Doki)') are auto-selected even when the MKV container does not set the forced flag bit. Kodi's forced_only locale mode only matches the flag bit, not the track name, so authored 'Forced' tracks without the bit were being skipped. v0.1.0 - Initial release. Auto-selects Signs/Songs subtitle tracks on playback start.
